scoring.precision: true commitments / all items labeled commitment; any non_commitments entry labeled commitment is a false positive
scoring.classification: per task T1..T7, does the tool's bucket match 'expected'?

formats._about: Format test corpus in seed/formats/, generated by seed/formats/build.py. Upload these files to The Corporation to see what the cycle does with each format. They do not change C01 to C09; npm run eval reports them separately and they never fail it.

handling_legend.scanned: Supported type under 5 MB: classified, extracted and evidence-checked.
handling_legend.scanned_no_text_layer: PDF with no text layer. Scanned (or an error if Box has no extracted text for it), but /ai/extract has no OCR and there is no text to check evidence against, so its commitments are not expected to be found yet.
handling_legend.skipped_type: Extension not in the supported list: skipped by the inventory, no AI call.
handling_legend.skipped_size: Over the 5 MB limit: skipped by the inventory, no AI call.
handling_legend.error: Scanned, but Box cannot produce its text: expect an entry in the page's errors, and the cycle continues.

standup_docx.note: Smart quotes, an em dash and bullets test evidence normalization.

stapler_pdf.note: Table cells must not scramble the evidence sentence.

roadmap_pptx.note: C14 is only in the speaker notes: the run shows whether Box's text includes notes.

tracker_xlsx.note: Evidence is a row, not a sentence, so the evidence check may drop it. The cancelled row and the Ideas sheet must not become findings.

reserves_scan7.note: C19 is on page 2 and C18 on page 6. With an OCR path, a 5-page limit would drop C18 silently.

contract_mixed.note: C21 is on a text page; C20 is only on the scanned page.

whiteboard_png.note: OCR candidate. Shorthand owner 'TUX' and date 'Nov 7'.

notice_tiff.note: OCR candidate. Recurring commitment with no due date.

chat_webp.note: OCR candidate. 'I' resolves to the message author (Pixel).

tokyo_docx.note: Katakana aliases resolve (タキシード = Tuxedo, ピクセル = Pixel); タマ支社長 has no Box user and is flagged; 来週金曜日 ('next Friday') is relative and is flagged, not guessed.

tokyo_png.note: OCR candidate. Date written in the Reiwa era (令和8年 = 2026); ビスケッツ卿 = Sir Reginald Biscuits.

rehearsal_vtt.note: Plain text, but .vtt is not in the supported list. If it is added, 'I' should resolve to the speaker label.

oversize_pdf.note: Holds C30, so a failed size check shows up as a finding.

empty_txt.note: No findings; an error entry from Box AI is acceptable, a crash is not.
